findings.summary: `await c.req.json()` rejects malformed bodies before Zod, bypassing the planned ValidationError wrap (ARCHITECTURE §5.2)
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap `c.req.json()` in try/catch and throw `new ValidationError('Malformed JSON body')` on parse failure so the error envelope code is `VALIDATION`, not `INTERNAL`.

findings.summary: vi.mock specifier '../../shared/env.ts' does not match the production import '../../shared/env.js'; mock is dead weight
findings.suggested_fix: Change `vi.mock('../../shared/env.ts', …)` to `vi.mock('../../shared/env.js', …)` (and the same for './tokens.ts' / '../../db/client.ts') to align with the `.js` extension convention the rest of the codebase uses.

findings.summary: Tokens module mock specifier './tokens.ts' diverges from service.ts import './tokens.ts' style elsewhere; consistency suggests aligning all vi.mock specifiers to the chosen extension
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one extension convention for vi.mock specifiers across the suite (recommend `.js` per workspace convention) and apply uniformly to the three vi.mock calls.

findings.summary: Comment claims 'GET /auth.me — authn-required (no CSRF — GET is exempt by csrf middleware)' but task spec says me requires CSRF+authn; resolve the doc/spec drift
findings.suggested_fix: Either document the GET-exempt behavior in the task spec / feature brief, or change `auth.me` to POST so CSRF middleware actually runs. Current behavior is consistent with csrf.ts STATE_CHANGING_METHODS but contradicts the wave-8 task description.

findings.summary: `loadEnv` is mocked but service.ts only imports the eager `env` singleton; the loadEnv part of the mock is unused
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the `loadEnv` key from the `vi.mock('../../shared/env.js', …)` factory unless a future test path needs it; keeps the mock surface minimal.
